claims: The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (Commander), Victor Glover (Pilot), Christina Koch (Mission Specialist), and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist).
Artemis II is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 2026.
The Artemis II crew is a four-person team.
The Artemis II crew will fly the Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
Artemis II is a roughly 10-day flight test.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the vicinity of the Moon since 1972.
Reid Wiseman is a veteran of the International Space Station.
Reid Wiseman is a former Chief of the Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover is a U.S. Navy test pilot.
Victor Glover will be the first Black person to travel into deep space.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch will be the first woman to travel to the vicinity of the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen will be the first non-U.S. citizen to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The Artemis II crew will test the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
The Artemis II crew will perform a free-return trajectory around the far side of the Moon.
The Artemis II crew will splash down in the Pacific Ocean.
